method: Automated inventory read every source, evidence, pathway, profile and review record in the exact manifest candidate for this ISO.

Automated screening compared source references, locators, geography fields, evidence class, direction, status, horizon and scenario; it checked pathway support IDs, link-evidence sets, geography fields, alternatives and uncertainty for follow-up.

Raw extraction access rows are recorded only as inherited access observations. This generated screen does not treat snippets, HTTP success, prior access, or metadata as claim verification and does not replace semantic source review.

source_refs.locator: Chapter 4, section A, printed p. 59 (PDF p. 65), climate trends and drought effects.

evidence.compact_statement: Report estimates 1.5°C warming since the 1950s and rainfall decline from 85 mm (1950) to 63 mm (2020); June 2020-November 2022 drought affected up to one-third of people and worsened food insecurity.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: Chapter 4, section A, printed p. 59 (PDF p. 65), flood impacts.

evidence.compact_statement: The report states that floods occur nearly once every two years, have destroyed villages and livestock, and on several occasions disrupted at least 10,000 livelihoods and caused about 10 deaths.

pathways.compact_statement: Around Mbera, climate-related resource pressure can interact with longstanding grievances and grazing/water access; tensions are conditional, not inevitable.
alternative_explanations: Historical resentments, representation, services and insecurity in neighbouring Mali also shape pressures.
pathways.uncertainty: Source-stated conditional pathway in an executive summary; underlying incident evidence not reviewed, not proof that climate caused armed violence.
recommendations: Retain only evidence whose documented geography supports the pathway location; otherwise narrow the pathway or keep the evidence standalone.
